Who am I ✺

As a Medical Virtual Assistant, I help healthcare practices run smoothly through organized, accurate, and HIPAA-compliant support. With 6+ years in healthcare customer service and quality control, I provide tailored solutions that fit each practice’s workflow and needs.

Accuracy comes from a careful process, built on years of experience in healthcare support and a commitment to protecting patient information.

What I bring to the table

Healthcare Insurance Customer Service

Insurance inquiries, eligibility verification, benefits clarification, and coverage concerns handled accurately and courteously.

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Support

Billing operations, claims processing, payment inquiries, claim follow-ups, and billing discrepancy resolution.

Patient Coordination & Referral Management

Referral coordination, appointment-related requests, status monitoring, and communication between patients and providers.

Administrative & Data Management

Daily admin tasks, organized records, database updates, documentation, and accurate data entry.

Quality Assurance & Process Improvement

Reviewing transactions and workflows for accuracy, spotting inconsistencies, and recommending improvements.

Customer Relations & Resolution

Clear, empathetic support that resolves concerns and keeps relationships positive.

Healthcare Documentation

Healthcare records, referral letters, billing documents, and medical correspondence, handled with confidentiality.

Sample work ✺

01

Patient referral intake form

A streamlined referral system that simplifies intake, centralizes patient records, prioritizes urgent cases, and tracks referrals from submission to completion.

02

Patient referral intake database

A centralized database that organizes patient records, monitors referral destinations, assigns priorities, and tracks case statuses.

03

Patient referral intake overall dashboard

A real-time overview of referral performance: total referrals, completed cases, urgent requests, priorities, and referral sources.

04

Provider’s referral letter

A clear, professional letter for communicating patient information, clinical findings, and referral details while protecting confidentiality.

05

External provider’s referral form

A professional cardiology referral form that streamlines intake, organizes clinical information, and supports coordination between providers.
